findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 356 requests to 91 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 8.9 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 6.0 MB (67%) came from third-party domains, 2.2 MB of it from services classified as tracking (240 requests).

55 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising).
134 cookies were set by third-party domains (181 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag.
